memberdef.name: GlobalObject

briefdescription.para: FIXME: Remove this function once transition to Align is over.
Returns the alignment of the given variable or function.

detaileddescription.para: Note that for functions this is the alignment of the code, not the alignment of a function pointer.

briefdescription.para: Sets the alignment attribute of the GlobalObject.
Sets the alignment attribute of the GlobalObject.

detaileddescription.para: This method will be deprecated as the alignment property should always be defined.

briefdescription.para: Check if this global has a custom object file section.

detaileddescription.para: This is more efficient than calling getSection() and checking for an empty string.

briefdescription.para: Get the custom section of this global if it has one.

detaileddescription.para: If this global does not have a custom section, this will be empty and the default object file section (.text, .data, etc) will be used.

briefdescription.para: Change the section for this global.

detaileddescription.para: Setting the section to the empty string tells LLVM to choose an appropriate default object file section.

briefdescription.para: Copy metadata from Src, adjusting offsets by Offset.
Returns true if the alignment of the value can be unilaterally increased.

detaileddescription.para: Note that for functions this is the alignment of the code, not the alignment of a function pointer.

briefdescription.para: Erase all metadata attached to this Value.
Erase all metadata attachments with the given kind.

simplesect.para: true if any metadata was removed.

briefdescription.para: Erase all metadata attachments matching the given predicate.
Appends all metadata attached to this value to MDs, sorting by KindID.

detaileddescription.para: The first element of each pair returned is the KindID, the second element is the metadata value. Attachments with the same ID appear in insertion order.

briefdescription.para: Get the current metadata attachments for the given kind, if any.

detaileddescription.para: These functions require that the value have at most a single attachment of the given kind, and return nullptr if such an attachment is missing.

briefdescription.para: Appends all attachments with the given ID to MDs in insertion order.

detaileddescription.para: If the Value has no attachments with the given ID, or if ID is invalid, leaves MDs unchanged.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this value has any metadata attached to it.
Return true if this value has the given type of metadata attached.
Set a particular kind of metadata attachment.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the given attachment to MD, erasing it if MD is nullptr or replacing it if it already exists.
